findings.evidence: The declarations rewrite `fdBoundary H (4 - t)` and `deriv (fdBoundary H) (4 - t)` to expressions at `t`; `rg` confirms these are the only four `four_sub` boundary declarations and none carries an automation attribute.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to all four reflection lemmas; their interval hypotheses prevent unconditional firing and their right-hand sides contain no reflected argument, so the rules terminate.
findings.issue: `fdBoundary_four_sub_vertical`, `fdBoundary_four_sub_arc` (line 495), and their derivative counterparts in `Deriv.lean` lines 227 and 236 orient reflected terms to their direct normal forms but lack `@[simp]`.

summary: The four reflection identities are canonical rewrite rules but are absent from the simplifier, leaving downstream contour calculations unable to normalize reflected boundary values and derivatives automatically.
